direct_evidence.title: 2026-09-30-rcs-29126-comentario-interno
direct_evidence.body:
Internal note. VF Corp, investigation to case conversion. Two blank exported PDFs and one case without subject.

Read-only check on the VF Corp Platform DB, factboard.Board, 9/30:
Board 5, Ray Nichols-TNF 20 Somerset, created 8/17. CaseID 451, CaseRecordNumber 2026-150020-1, StatusID 3.
Board 6, Ryan Yakow-TNF 20, created 8/25. CaseID 461, CaseRecordNumber 2026-150020-2, StatusID 3.
Board 7, Aarya Datta, created 9/21. CaseID 482, CaseRecordNumber 2026-150020-3, StatusID 3.

Finding 1. The exported PDF attached to cases 2026-150020-1 and 2026-150020-2 opens blank, with only a # symbol and the logo. The PDF for 2026-150020-3, generated on 9/21 at 1:58 PM, contains all 17 events. This matches ENG-6676 and RCS-28006 (Casey's) and ENG-7440 / ARPP-644 (Bunnings).

Finding 2. Case 2026-150020-2 (MasterCaseID 461) exists and opens by URL, but it has no subject name and does not appear in the customer's Active Cases list. The customer could not locate it for that reason.

Requests for Engineering:

direct_evidence.title: 2026-09-30-rcs-29126-respuesta-mike
direct_evidence.body:
Hi Mike,

Thank you for your patience while we looked into this, and for the detail in your original note. It made it much easier to follow what you were seeing.

I went through the three investigations that show as In Case in your Secure account and matched each one to its case in Secure Incident.

Aarya Datta, case 2026-150020-3: the search results did come across. When an investigation is moved to a case, the results are delivered as a PDF under Manage Attachments rather than in the Items section. The file 2026-150020-3-exported_pdf_7.pdf holds all 17 transactions, including the ones on the card ending 0410.

Ryan Yakow, case 2026-150020-2: the case was created, and you can open it directly from this link:
https://apps.lpguys.net/vfcorp/nettrack/LPMS/lpmseditmenu.aspx?MasterCaseID=461&ShopliftingID=461&SuspectID=461&StoreIdent=1060
It looks like the case came across without a subject name, which may be why it is not showing up in your Active Cases list.
